name: Thang den
summary: Round sticky-rice balls filled with crushed mung beans, boiled and served hot with coconut milk and ginger, sweet and slightly rich. Think of Hanoi’s floating cakes, not thắng cố.
howToEat: Eat the balls hot with coconut milk and a ginger drink.
They are close to Hà Nội floating cake, Lạng Sơn cong cake, and chè trôi nước.
where: On the plateau, and in Đồng Văn.
seoTitle: Thang den in Ha Giang — sticky rice balls
seoDescription: Thắng dền are hot sticky-rice balls filled with mung beans, served with coconut milk and ginger. They are not thắng cố.
